caption: The drawing consists of abstract and geometric shapes rendered primarily in black and red on a background shaded with gray. On the right side, there is a vertical, symmetrical figure outlined in red with patterns and markings within, resembling a stylized human or anthropomorphic design, with circular shapes near its head and arms extending outward. Surrounding this central figure are a series of black, triangular and circular shapes, some outlined in red. Towards the left, there is a large, jagged, red line forming an irregular enclosed shape, within which lies a black, paddle-like object with a red band. Several concentric circles and bullseye patterns, mostly in black and red, are scattered between the main figure and the left side of the drawing. The surface is covered with fine, even gray shading except for a few clear areas. There are also smaller red circular motifs, zigzag lines, and assorted markings throughout the composition.
title: Petroglyphs - Human Figures
